summary: Iteration-3 frontend-only verification of Pro Photo Sorter (https://photo-sorter-30.preview.emergentagent.com). Ran 3 Playwright sessions covering app load, Keyboard Shortcuts modal (new peek shortcut), SettingsModal Cancel bugfix from iteration 2, minStarFilter save/persistence + chip visibility gate, Category Manager / Batch / Editor button states, plus static source review of ImageEditor.jsx for all required data-testids. Result: 8/8 testable items PASS, 0 console errors, 0 compile errors (1 pre-existing eslint react-hooks warning). Editor runtime behaviour (rotate/contrast/saturation/peek rendering) NOT executed - blocked by File System Access API picker as noted by main agent; verified by source inspection only.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close the modal and there is no visible/testable close button - only overlay click or re-pressing '?'. Playwright click on toolbar buttons was blocked by the modal overlay after Escape (overlay intercepts pointer events). Same pattern likely applies to SettingsModal (no Escape handler).

keydown/keyup peek handler does not skip when focus is in an input/textarea (App.js keyboard handler does guard this). If any text field is ever focused inside the editor, typing '\' or '`' would trigger peek and preventDefault would block the character.

issues: Shortcut list renders cleanly; new row 'Hold to peek original (in editor)' with kbd '\ or `' is present and consistent with other rows - no design defect found.
Layout, live template preview and star-filter segmented control render correctly with adequate contrast at 1920x1080 - no defect found.

action_items: Optional: add an Escape key handler (and a data-testid close button) to the help modal and settings modal so keyboard users / automation can dismiss them; the full-screen overlay currently blocks all toolbar clicks until dismissed via overlay click or '?'.
Optional: guard the ImageEditor peek keydown handler against active input/textarea focus, mirroring App.js.

Optional cleanup: App.js (899 lines) and ImageEditor.jsx (659 lines) are large - consider splitting toolbar/filmstrip and editor control-panel into sub-modules. Also fix the react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warning for 'appliedIcons' (App.js line 96).
critical_code_review_comments: SettingsModal iteration-2 bug is correctly fixed via useEffect([open, settings]) re-sync of local state; verified at runtime (Cancel after Move + Studio-format preset + >=4 star filter reverts to Copy + {folder}/{labels}{ext} + All).
Rating filter chip is correctly gated by (settings.minStarFilter||0) > 0 && images.length > 0 (App.js ~760); confirmed chip absent with minStarFilter=3 and 0 images loaded.
ImageEditor peek path correctly bypasses rotation (totalDeg=0), CSS filters (filter='none') and sharpen bitmap while peeking, and resets on mouseup/mouseleave/touchend - implementation is sound.

Angle slider is min=-15 max=15 step=0.1 as specified; crop is properly disabled when rotation/angle != 0 with an explanatory hint, and save pipeline applies rotation before crop guarded by the same condition.
seed_data_creation: None. Test mutated localStorage key pps.state.v2 (minStarFilter set to 3 then restored to 0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Toolbar testids: show-help (NOT open-shortcuts), open-settings, open-category-manager, toggle-batch, open-editor (disabled with no image), pick-source-btn, pick-dest-btn, mode-indicator, filmstrip. Help modal testid = help-modal, toggled by '?' key (Escape does NOT close it - after opening it you must click the overlay or press '?' again, otherwise its overlay intercepts all subsequent clicks and Playwright will time out). Settings testids: mode-copy/mode-move, preset-studio-format etc., template-input, star-filter-0..5, settings-cancel, settings-save. ImageEditor.jsx contains all required testids: peek-original, peek-badge, rotate-cw, rotate-ccw, angle-slider, angle-value, angle-reset, brightness-slider, contrast-slider, saturation-slider, sharpen-slider, crop-toggle, editor-save, editor-close (brightness/contrast/saturation are generated by the shared showSlider helper as ${testid}-slider/-value). Untestable areas remain: File System Access API folder pickers, real image load, filmstrip thumbnails, star-filter chip visual, and all editor canvas rendering.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration-2 Cancel bug root cause was SettingsModal seeding useState(settings) only on first mount so the modal kept stale dirty local state; fixed with a useEffect that re-syncs local from settings whenever open flips true. Verified non-reproducible. The only new finding (help modal not closable via Escape) is because App.js registers only a '?' toggle for showHelp and the modal's absolute inset-0 overlay swallows pointer events while open.
